title: A/P: a bill with no due date is not listed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has an unpaid bill (received delivery) with no due date.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket.
  4. Look for vendor Y's bill.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • the bill without a due date is not listed.

Why this matters: Unchanged inclusion rules keep A/P totals equal to before the release.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:96; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingSummaryFetcher.php:103. V1 code, quoted: `->andWhere('vt.due_date IS NOT NULL')`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-037) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
